info.name: Ward of the Sheltering Hands
info.description: The Ward of the Sheltering Hands background from Arcana Unleashed.

ul.li: Equipment: Choose A or B: (A) Cook's Utensils, Blanket, Healer's Kit, Lamp, Oil (3 flasks), Tinderbox, Traveler's Clothes, Waterskin, 40 GP; or (B) 50 GP

description.p: A turn of ill luck led you to the Sheltering Hands, an altruistic organization dedicated to defending the downtrodden. The organization helped you regain your footing and taught you some of its protective magic—in the hope that one day you too would shelter the less fortunate in their time of need.

setters.set: Constitution, Wisdom, Charisma, Arcane Safeguard Feat, Insight and Medicine Skills, Cook's Utensils
